correctness.rationale: For n,k positive, graph distance in P_n^k is ceil(|u-v|/k). On each modulo-k residue class, between endpoints a<c with c-a a multiple of k, the shortest path must make only +k jumps and is uniquely the intervening residue chain. Thus a mutually visible color class contains at most two of each residue (size<=2k), and a noncomplete graph needs at least two classes. If n<=k+1 the graph is complete. For k+2<=n<=2k two contiguous cliques suffice; for n>2k put t=ceil(n/(2k)) and divide P_{2kt}^k into t classes, each two length-k blocks t blocks apart. For cross-block offsets alpha,beta, the constructed monotone internal route avoids both blocks and has length t+1_{beta>alpha}, including t=2,beta<alpha special route, so is shortest. Truncate prefix to n: monotone geodesics remain inside endpoints. Independent forbidden-internal-vertex BFS verified construction for all 520 pairs 1<=k<=8,1<=n<=65; it is a diagnostic, not infinite proof.
residual_risks: No powers of cycles, other unit interval graphs, or independent/total visibility colorings.
